title: Lightning Storms: The Hidden Power You Never See
hook: Your phone just got hit by a bolt from the sky.
script: Your phone just got hit by a bolt from the sky. What if we could turn that same force into power? Lightning isn’t just light — it’s a massive electrical discharge, hotter than the surface of the Sun. The Empire State Building is struck 25 times a year. Each bolt carries enough energy to power your house for three months. But the real surprise is where that energy ends up. Storms don’t just ground their power — they shoot it upward. Sprites and blue jets leap 100 kilometers into the air, rewiring the sky itself. And that means everything you know about weather is wrong.
